title: centaurium portense
intro: Centaurium portense, commonly known as Portentilla, is a plant species in the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of the Balkans and parts of Central and Eastern Europe. The health benefits of Centaurium portense include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and xanthones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
